title: Elodie and the Spire
author: Oscar Villalobos
blurb: Edmund Fairweather, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
